provenance.notes: All values are extracted from local CSX-144 package files without network access.

criteria.description: Returns only the requested compact JSON structure and gives consistent_giant_hail_threshold_context_ledger as both answer and final score label.
criteria.name: Final JSON contract and label
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a mostly correct structure or label with minor naming omissions; no credit if the output is prose-only or gives a conflicting final label.

criteria.description: Uses 19 cm for Azzano Decimo and correctly computes severe ratio 9.5, giant ratio 3.8, previous-record ratio 1.188, and world-record gap 1.3 cm.
criteria.name: Hail threshold arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for using 19 cm with one or two arithmetic or rounding errors; 1 point for recognizing the giant-hail threshold without the record comparisons.

criteria.description: Reports Azzano Decimo, Italy; normalizes the hit to 2023-07-24 about 23:00; and marks both date-in-window and Italy match as true.
criteria.name: Time and place matching
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the right place or date but missing the late-evening normalization or one boolean check.

criteria.description: Reports GPM 46.155 mm, ERA5-Land 21.954 mm, and rounded WorldPop 1025289.
criteria.name: Weather and population context
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for two correct context values with tolerable rounding; 1 point for identifying the needed metric family but not computing the package precipitation summaries.

criteria.description: Reports AlphaEarth mean 0.039874, AlphaEarth maximum 0.525615, RGB mean absolute difference 80.36, two-day lead time, and event_image_post_hit false.
criteria.name: Remote-sensing timing metrics
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct image timing but missing one or more numeric metrics; no credit for treating the 2023-07-22 image as post-hit.

criteria.description: Computes 6 passed checks out of 6, 100.0 percent, and explains that the remote-sensing result is contextual rather than direct damage confirmation.
criteria.name: Final score and bounded interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a correct score with a weak interpretation, or a correct bounded statement with an arithmetic slip.
